title: Lab - Persistent Volume Claims
description: Provision storage and bind a claim.
scenario: Provision storage and bind a claim. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Inspect
tasks.instructions: Where does Pod webapp write its logs, and why are they lost on restart?
tasks.solution:
kubectl exec webapp -- cat /log/app.log
kubectl get pod webapp -o jsonpath='{.spec.volumes}'

tasks.title: Task 2 - PV
tasks.instructions: Create PV pv-log: 100Mi, ReadWriteMany, hostPath /pv/log, reclaim Retain.

tasks.title: Task 3 - PVC
tasks.instructions: Create PVC claim-log-1 for 50Mi ReadWriteMany and mount it at /log in webapp.
